summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of using the value of an Enum object instead of its name in migrations, which can cause problems with translations. However, there are concerns about potential regressions and maintainability.

issues.description: There is a risk that this change may break existing migrations that rely on the current behavior of serializing Enum values.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify that the change does not introduce regressions or handle all edge cases.
The code change could be improved for readability by adding comments explaining the rationale behind using the Enum name instead of its value.
